name: com.agentopsboard/jobs
title: Agent Ops Jobs
description: Search verified fractional, contract and part-time AI & Agent Ops jobs, and post a role for $149.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search active Agent Ops Jobs listings. Featured roles are listed first among the matches. Each result includes a featured boolean. Does not include closed roles.

query.description: Words matched against title, company, location, summary, and tags.

employment_type.description: contract also matches contract-to-hire and other contract listings. part-time and fractional match listings whose type contains that word.

remote.description: True keeps remote roles. False keeps hybrid and on-site roles.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch one active listing by its slug, the id used in /jobs/<slug>/.

tools.name: get_posting_info
tools.description: Price, what a post includes, the manual review, and the exact steps to purchase a listing. No arguments.

tools.name: submit_job_post
tools.description: Submit a fractional, part-time, contract, or freelance role. Returns a submission id and the $149 Stripe payment link. featured true also returns featured_addon ($99 USD for 30 days) and does not change that link. Does not publish the role and does not charge a card. Jay reviews it before it goes live.
